passages.text: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Moab, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because he burned to lime the bones of Edom’s king.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD is just and powerful.
The LORD says this about Moab.
Moab has sinned many times.
Moab has committed three sins.
Moab has committed even a fourth sin.
The LORD will not take back His punishment.
Moab burned the bones of the king of Edom.
Moab turned the bones into lime.
The LORD will judge Moab for this evil act.
passages.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב וְעַל־ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־ שָׂרְפ֛וֹ עַצְמ֥וֹת מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֱד֖וֹם לַשִּֽׂיד׃

passages.text: So I will send fire against Moab to consume the citadels of Kerioth. Moab will die in tumult, amid war cries and the sound of the ram’s horn.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD will send fire against Moab.
The fire will destroy the strongholds of Kerioth.
Moab will die in great confusion.
There will be loud shouting.
There will be the sound of a ram’s horn.
passages.original: וְשִׁלַּחְתִּי־ אֵ֣שׁ בְּמוֹאָ֔ב וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֣וֹת הַקְּרִיּ֑וֹת וּמֵ֤ת בְּשָׁאוֹן֙ מוֹאָ֔ב בִּתְרוּעָ֖ה בְּק֥וֹל שׁוֹפָֽר׃

passages.text: I will cut off the ruler of Moab and kill all the officials with him,” says the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD will act against Moab.
The LORD will remove Moab’s ruler.
The LORD will kill all Moab’s officials with the ruler.
The LORD has declared this.
passages.original: וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י שׁוֹפֵ֖ט מִקִּרְבָּ֑הּ וְכָל־ שָׂרֶ֛יהָ אֶהֱר֥וֹג עִמּ֖וֹ אָמַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃פ

passages.text: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Judah, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they reject the Law of the LORD and fail to keep His statutes; they are led astray by the lies in which their fathers walked.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks these words.
The LORD addresses the people of Judah.
Judah has committed many sins.
Judah has committed three sins, even four.
The LORD will not take back His judgment against Judah.
Judah rejects the Law of the LORD.
Judah does not keep the LORD’s statutes.
Judah follows lies.
Judah’s fathers also followed these lies.
These lies lead Judah astray.
passages.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וְעַל־ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַֽל־ מָאֳסָ֞ם אֶת־ תּוֹרַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה וְחֻקָּיו֙ לֹ֣א שָׁמָ֔רוּ וַיַּתְעוּם֙ כִּזְבֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ הָלְכ֥וּ אֲבוֹתָ֖ם אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: So I will send fire upon Judah to consume the citadels of Jerusalem.”
passages.sermon: The LORD speaks.\r\nThe LORD will send fire on Judah.\r\nThe fire will burn the strong buildings of Jerusalem.
passages.original: וְשִׁלַּ֥חְתִּי אֵ֖שׁ בִּֽיהוּדָ֑ה וְאָכְלָ֖ה אַרְמְנ֥וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ

passages.text: This is what the LORD says: “For three transgressions of Israel, even four, I will not revoke My judgment, because they sell the righteous for silver and the needy for a pair of sandals.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD is just and holy.
The LORD says this about Israel.
Israel has sinned many times.
Israel has committed three sins, even four.
The LORD will not take away His punishment.
Israel sells righteous people for silver.
Israel sells needy people for a pair of sandals.
The LORD will judge Israel for these actions.
passages.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה עַל־ שְׁלֹשָׁה֙ פִּשְׁעֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְעַל־ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה לֹ֣א אֲשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ עַל־ מִכְרָ֤ם בַּכֶּ֙סֶף֙ צַדִּ֔יק וְאֶבְי֖וֹן בַּעֲב֥וּר נַעֲלָֽיִם׃

passages.text: They trample on the heads of the poor as on the dust of the earth; they push the needy out of their way. A man and his father have relations with the same girl and so profane My holy name.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel act with great injustice.
They oppress the poor.
They treat the poor like the dust of the earth.
They push the needy aside.
They do not care for the humble.
A man and his father both go to the same young woman.
They commit this sin together.
They do this to dishonor My holy name.
They bring shame to God’s name by their actions.
passages.original: הַשֹּׁאֲפִ֤ים עַל־ עֲפַר־ אֶ֙רֶץ֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ דַּלִּ֔ים וְדֶ֥רֶךְ עֲנָוִ֖ים יַטּ֑וּ וְאִ֣ישׁ וְאָבִ֗יו יֵֽלְכוּ֙ אֶל־ הַֽנַּעֲרָ֔ה לְמַ֥עַן חַלֵּ֖ל אֶת־ שֵׁ֥ם קָדְשִֽׁי׃

passages.text: They lie down beside every altar on garments taken in pledge. And in the house of their God, they drink wine obtained through fines.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel act unjustly.
They take garments from others as a pledge.
They keep these garments.
They lie down beside every altar on these garments.
They do this at places of worship.
They drink wine in the house of their God.
They buy this wine with money taken as fines.
passages.original: וְעַל־ בְּגָדִ֤ים חֲבֻלִים֙ יַטּ֔וּ אֵ֖צֶל כָּל־ מִזְבֵּ֑חַ וְיֵ֤ין עֲנוּשִׁים֙ יִשְׁתּ֔וּ בֵּ֖ית אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Yet it was I who destroyed the Amorite before them, though his height was like that of the cedars, and he was as strong as the oaks. Yet I destroyed his fruit above and his roots below.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
God destroyed the Amorite people before Israel.
The Amorites were very tall, like cedar trees.
The Amorites were very strong, like oak trees.
God destroyed the fruit of the Amorites above.
God destroyed the roots of the Amorites below.
passages.original: וְאָ֨נֹכִ֜י הִשְׁמַ֤דְתִּי אֶת־ הָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר כְּגֹ֤בַהּ אֲרָזִים֙ גָּבְה֔וֹ וְחָסֹ֥ן ה֖וּא כָּֽאַלּוֹנִ֑ים וָאַשְׁמִ֤יד פִּרְיוֹ֙ מִמַּ֔עַל וְשָׁרָשָׁ֖יו מִתָּֽחַת׃

passages.text: And I brought you up from the land of Egypt and led you forty years in the wilderness, that you might take possession of the land of the Amorite.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God said, “I brought you up from the land of Egypt.
You were slaves in Egypt.
I led you out of Egypt.
I guided you in the wilderness for forty years.
I did this so you could take possession of the land of the Amorite.
I gave you the land of the Amorite.”
passages.original: וְאָנֹכִ֛י הֶעֱלֵ֥יתִי אֶתְכֶ֖ם מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וָאוֹלֵ֨ךְ אֶתְכֶ֤ם בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה לָרֶ֖שֶׁת אֶת־ אֶ֥רֶץ הָאֱמֹרִֽי׃

passages.text: I raised up prophets from your sons and Nazirites from your young men. Is this not true, O children of Israel?” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to the people of Israel.
The LORD says, “I chose some of your sons.
I made them prophets.
I chose some of your young men.
I made them Nazirites.
Children of Israel, this is true.
The LORD declares this.”
passages.original: וָאָקִ֤ים מִבְּנֵיכֶם֙ לִנְבִיאִ֔ים וּמִבַּחוּרֵיכֶ֖ם לִנְזִרִ֑ים הַאַ֥ף אֵֽין־ זֹ֛את בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: “But you made the Nazirites drink wine and commanded the prophets not to prophesy.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel acted against God’s chosen servants.
You gave wine to the Nazirites.
Nazirites took a vow to avoid wine.
You forced them to break their vow.
You told the prophets not to prophesy.
Prophets spoke God’s messages.
You commanded them to be silent.
passages.original: וַתַּשְׁק֥וּ אֶת־ הַנְּזִרִ֖ים יָ֑יִן וְעַל־ הַנְּבִיאִים֙ צִוִּיתֶ֣ם לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֖א תִּנָּבְאֽוּ׃

passages.text: Behold, I am about to crush you in your place as with a cart full of grain.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to Israel.
The LORD says, “I will crush you where you are.
I will press you down.
I will do this as a cart full of grain crushes what is beneath it.”
passages.original: הִנֵּ֛ה אָנֹכִ֥י מֵעִ֖יק תַּחְתֵּיכֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר תָּעִיק֙ הָעֲגָלָ֔ה הַֽמְלֵאָ֥ה לָ֖הּ עָמִֽיר׃

passages.text: Escape will fail the swift, the strong will not prevail by his strength, and the mighty will not save his life.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God warns them of coming judgment.
The swift person will not escape.
The strong person will not succeed by his strength.
The mighty person will not save his own life.
passages.original: וְאָבַ֤ד מָנוֹס֙ מִקָּ֔ל וְחָזָ֖ק לֹא־ יְאַמֵּ֣ץ כֹּח֑וֹ וְגִבּ֖וֹר לֹא־ יְמַלֵּ֥ט נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

passages.text: The archer will not stand his ground, the fleet of foot will not escape, and the horseman will not save his life.
passages.sermon: The archer will not stand his ground.\r\nThe fast runner will not escape.\r\nThe horseman will not save his life.
passages.original: וְתֹפֵ֤שׂ הַקֶּ֙שֶׁת֙ לֹ֣א יַעֲמֹ֔ד וְקַ֥ל בְּרַגְלָ֖יו לֹ֣א יְמַלֵּ֑ט וְרֹכֵ֣ב הַסּ֔וּס לֹ֥א יְמַלֵּ֖ט נַפְשֽׁוֹ׃

passages.text: Even the bravest of mighty men will flee naked on that day,” declares the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to Israel.
The LORD says what will happen on that day.
The bravest men are mighty warriors.
Even the bravest warriors will run away.
They will flee without clothes.
This will happen on that day.
The LORD has declared it.
passages.original: וְאַמִּ֥יץ לִבּ֖וֹ בַּגִּבּוֹרִ֑ים עָר֛וֹם יָנ֥וּס בַּיּוֹם־ הַה֖וּא נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃פ
